3. V1 — SHAP Explainability

SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) shows how each geometric feature pushes the model's prediction. Red bars increase the predicted class score; blue bars decrease it.

4. V2 — Grad-CAM Visualisations

Grad-CAM heatmaps show which image regions the MobileNetV2 CNN attends to when predicting each class. Warm colours (red/yellow) = high attention.

LEFT prediction

5. V2 — Uncertainty Quantification (MC Dropout)

Monte Carlo Dropout runs 20 stochastic forward passes per frame. Frames below the 80% confidence threshold are flagged for human review.

6. V2 — Calibration Curve

A well-calibrated model has points close to the diagonal. This checks whether the CNN's confidence scores are trustworthy (e.g., 80% confident → correct ~80% of the time).
